records.text: Citing a May 20th, 2025 Instagram post, Owens said Tyler Clancy received the LaGrand and Beth Baker Award for his work as a Provo special victims detective helping rescue children, dismantle human trafficking rings and bring predators to justice.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Check out this Instagram post from 2025. It reads, this was posted on May 20th, it reads, Rep Tyler Clancy doesn't just talk public safety, he lives it. ... Today he received the LaGrand and Beth Baker Award for his service as a detective in Provo PD's special victims unit where he helped. ... You guys got it. You know what I'm going to say. Rescue children, dismantle human trafficking rings and bring predators to justice.
